stories.title: A-level results day is Thursday 13 August: how Clearing works and who to call
stories.summary: A-level results are published on Thursday 13 August, and students in Flintshire collect them from 8am. Anyone without a confirmed university place can add a Clearing choice through UCAS from 1pm the same day. The University of Chester said its Clearing hotline will open at 8am on Thursday and stay open through the following weekend.

stories.title: More than 3,000 young people in north Wales have had a first meningitis B jab
stories.summary: More than 3,000 young people across north Wales have had a first dose of the meningitis B vaccine in the first two weeks of the campaign, Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board has said. stories.title: Former Flint mayor raises £500 for Wales Air Ambulance
stories.summary: The former Mayor of Flint has handed over £500 to the Wales Air Ambulance. Councillor Russ Davies chose the charity as one of the causes to benefit during his 2025-26 civic year, alongside Mayoress Councillor Norma Davies. The money was raised through a series of events across the year, ending with the Mayor’s Civic Ball.
